title: Basic katakana: R and W rows and ン — write in kana
description: Use Latin-letter syllable cues to recall and type the matching katakana signs. Kana answers only; no sign is displayed in the question.

exercises.prompt: From the Latin-letter spelling cue below, recall and type its katakana sign (not romaji).

stimulus.translation: Latin-letter cue for the basic katakana ra sign.

text.gloss: Katakana sign for the basic ra reading.

exercises.explanation: The katakana spelling for written ra is ラ. Katakana sign for the basic ra reading. Only the authored katakana spelling is accepted; hiragana is not an alias.
